description: Maps the people involved in a deal or account: classifies roles such as Champion, Economic Buyer, and Blocker, scores influence and relationship strength, plans multi-threading, watches for organizational change signals, and builds stakeholder maps, engagement plans, and Mutual Action Plans scaled to how many stakeholders are involved. Use when a rep asks who to engage in an account, wants a stakeholder or power map, needs a multi-threading or engagement strategy, is building a Mutual Action Plan, or is preparing stakeholders for a renewal.
